answer: Each identity binds one peer-reviewed paper via the DOI bridge: its DOI and author hash join the nebula registry, with a 30 POA bond locked 90 days, re-attested within 72 hours each epoch. The authorship thread ties one DOI to one identity; each extra paper from one cluster adds 30 POA to the bond. 100 fakes need 100 papers, 151,500 POA in bonds, and 75,000 POA for authorship slots doubling every 50 sold: 226,500 POA in all. Verifiers replay the DOI graph and check each signature; failed re-attestation forfeits half the bond and freezes payouts 3 epochs. One paper seeds one identity.
